},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436984029249536"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"始，則陽生焉；動之極，則陰生焉；一陰一陽交，","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903373364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"而天之用盡之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903373364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"靜之始，則柔生焉；靜之極，","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903389748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"則剛生焉；一柔一剛交，而地之用盡之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903389748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"動","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903406132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"之大者謂之太陽，動之小者謂之少陽；靜之","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903406132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"大者謂之太陰，靜之小者謂之少陰。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903406132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽爲","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903422516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"日，太陰爲月，少陽爲星，少陰爲辰。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903422516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"日月星辰","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903438900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"交，而天之體盡之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903438900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"太柔為水，","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903455284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"太剛為火，少柔爲土，少剛爲石。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903455284 56","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"物之走，風化物之飛，露化物之草，雷化物之","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903586356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"木。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903586356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"走飛草木交，而動植之應盡之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903602740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"走，感暑","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903619124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"而變者，性之走也；感寒而變者，情之走也；感","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903619124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"晝而變者，形之走也；感夜而變者，體之走也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903619124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"飛，感暑而變者，性之飛也；感寒而變者，情之","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903635508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"飛也；感晝而變者，形之飛也；感夜而變者，體","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903635508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"之飛也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903635508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"草，感暑而變者，性之草也；感寒而變","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903651892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436984029265920"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"者，情之草也；感晝而變者，形之草也；感夜","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903651892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"而變者，體之草也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903651892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":41, 28","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"體，應雨而化者，走","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903733812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"之體也；應風而化者，飛之體也；應露而化者，","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903733812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"草之體也；應雷而化者，木之體也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903733812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"性之走善","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903750196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"色，情之走善聲，形之走善氣，體之走善味。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903750196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"性","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903766580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"之飛善色，情之飛善聲，形之飛善氣，體之飛","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903766580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"善味。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903766580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"性之草善色，情之草善聲，形之草善氣，","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903782964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"體之草善味。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903782964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"性之木善色，情之木善聲，形之","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903799348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"木善氣，體之木善味。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903799348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"走之性善耳，飛之性善","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903815732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"目，草之性善口，木之性善鼻。","logicSe {"lines":[{"lineId":"105","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"人之所以能靈于萬物者，謂其目能收萬物","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903946804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"之色，耳能收萬物之聲，鼻能收萬物之氣，口","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903946804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436988890234899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"能收萬物之味。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903946804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"聲色氣味者，萬物之體也；目","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903963188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"耳鼻口者，萬人之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903963188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"體無定用，惟變是用；","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903979572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"用無定體，惟化是體。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903979572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"體用交，而人物之道于","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903995956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"是乎備矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051903995956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"然則人亦物也，聖亦人也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904012340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"有一物","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904028724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"之物，有十物之物，有百物之物，有千物之物，","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904028724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"有萬物之物，有億物之物，有兆物之物。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904028724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"爲兆","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904045108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"物之物，豈非人乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904045108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"有一人之人，有十人之人，","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904061492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"有百人之人，有千人之人，有萬人之人，有億","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904061492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"人之人，有兆人之人。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904061492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"爲兆人之人，豈非聖乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904077876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"是知人也者，物之至者也；聖也者，人之至者","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904094260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436984029233152"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904094260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"物之至者，始得謂之物之物也；人之至者，","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904110644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"始得謂之人之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904110644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"夫物之物者，至物之謂","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904127028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"也；人之人者，至人之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904127028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"以一至物而當一","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904143412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"至人，則非聖人而何？","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904143412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"人謂之不聖，則吾不信","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904159796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904159796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"何哉？","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904176180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"謂其能以一心觀萬心，一身觀萬身，","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904192564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"一物觀萬物，一世觀萬世者焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904192564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"又謂其能以","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904208948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"心代天意，口代天言，手代天功，身代天事者","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904208948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904208948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"又謂其能以上順天時，下應地理，中徇物","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904225332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"情，通盡人事者焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904225332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"又謂其能以彌綸天地，出","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904241716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"入造化，進退今古，表裏時事者焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904241716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"噫！","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904258100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人者，","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904274484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436988890251283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"非世世而效聖焉，吾不得而目見之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904274484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然，","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904290868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"吾不得而目見之，察其心，觀其跡，探其體，潜","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904290868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"其用，雖億萬千年，亦可以理知之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904290868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"人或告","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904307252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"我曰：天地之外，别有天地萬物，異乎此天地","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904307252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物，則吾不得而知之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904307252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"非唯吾不得而知","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904323636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"之也，聖人亦不得而知之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904323636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"凡言知者，謂其","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904340020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"心得而知之也；言言者，謂其口得而言之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904340020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"既心尚不得而知之，口又惡得而言之乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904356404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904372788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"不可得知而知之，是謂妄知也；以不可得言","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904372788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"而言之，是謂妄言也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904372788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"吾又安能從妄人而行","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904389172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436989402054693"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"妄知、妄言者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904389172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00031_0_2","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648854051904421940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：窮理盡性，以至于命。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904421940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"所以謂之理者，物","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904438324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"之理也；所以謂之性者，天之性也；所以謂之","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904438324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"命者，處理性者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904438324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"所以能處理性者，非道而","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904454708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"何？","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904454708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"是知道爲天地之本，天地爲萬物之本。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904471092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904487476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"天地觀萬物，則萬物爲萬物；以道觀天地，則","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904487476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"天地亦爲萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904487476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"道之道盡之于天矣，天之道","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904503860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"盡之于地矣；天地之道盡之于萬物矣；天地","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904503860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物之道盡之于人矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904503860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"人能知其天地萬物","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904520244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436989402185765"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"之道所以盡于人者，然後能盡民也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904520244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"天之能","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904536628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"盡物，則謂之曰昊天；人之能盡民，則謂之曰","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904536628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904536628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"謂昊天能異乎萬物，則非所以謂之昊","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904553012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"天也；謂聖人能異乎萬民，則非所以謂之聖","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904553012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"人也。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904553012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"萬民與萬物同，則聖人固不異乎昊天","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904569396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904569396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"然則聖人與昊天爲一道。","logicSentenceId":"7648854051904585780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人與昊天","logicSentenceId":"7648854051 {"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"三皇同意而異化，五帝同言而異教，三王同","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206586408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"象而異勸，五伯同數而異率。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206586408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"同意而異化者，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206602792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"必以道。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206602792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"以道化民者，民亦以道歸之，故尚自","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206619176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"然。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206619176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"夫自然者，無爲無有之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206635560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"無爲者，非不","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206651944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"爲也，不固爲者也，故能廣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206651944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"無有者，非不有也，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206668328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436988890300435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"不固有者也，故能大。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206668328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"廣大悉備，而不固爲固","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206684712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"有者，其唯三皇乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206684712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"是故知能以道化天下者，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206701096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"天下亦以道歸焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206701096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"所以聖人有言曰：我無爲","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206717480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"而民自化，我無事而民自富，我好靜而民自","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206717480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"正，我無欲而民自樸。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206717480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"其斯之謂歟？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206733864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"三皇同仁而異化，五帝同禮而異教，三王同","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206750248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"義而異勸，五伯同智而異率。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206750248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"同禮而異教者，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206766632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"必以德。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206766632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"以德教民者，民亦以德歸之，故尚讓。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206783016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"夫讓也者，先人後己之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206799400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"以天下授人而","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206815784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"不爲輕，若素無之也；受人之天下而不爲重，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206815784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436995701800995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"若素有之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206815784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"若素無素有者，謂不已無已有","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206832168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206832168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"若己無己有，則舉一毛以取與于人，猶","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206848552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"有貪鄙之心生焉，而况天下者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206848552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"能知其天","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206864936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"下之天下非己之天下者，其唯五帝乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206864936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"是故","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206881320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"知能以德教天下者，天下亦以德歸焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206881320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"所以","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206897704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人有言曰：垂衣裳而天下治，蓋取諸乾坤。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206897704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"其斯之謂歟！","logicSentenceId":"7648861491206914088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

:"7648861491207061544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"以王","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207077928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"去賊，安有弑君耶？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207077928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"是故知王者正也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207094312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"能以功","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207110696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"正天下之不正者，天下亦以功歸焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207110696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"所以聖","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207127080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"人有言曰：天地革而四時成焉，湯武革命，順","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207127080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"乎天而應乎人。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207127080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"其斯之謂歟！","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207143464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"三皇同聖而異化，五帝同賢而異教，三王同","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207159848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"才而異勸，五伯同術而異率。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207159848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"同術而異率者，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207176232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436995701833763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"必以力。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207176232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"以力率民者，民亦以力歸之，故尚爭。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207192616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"夫爭也者，爭夫利者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207209000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"取與利不以義，然後","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207225384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之爭。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207225384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"小爭交以言，大爭交以兵，爭夫强者","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207241768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"也，猶借夫名也者，謂之曲直。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207241768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"名也者，命物正","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207258152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"事之稱也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207258152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"利也者，養人成務之具也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207274536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"名不以","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207290920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"仁，無以守業；利不以義，無以居功。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207290920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"利不以功","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207307304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"居，名不以業守，則亂矣，民所以必爭之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207307304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"五","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207323688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"伯者，借虛名以爭實利者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207323688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"帝不足則王，王","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207340072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"不足則伯，伯又不足則夷狄矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207340072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"若然，則五伯","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207356456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"不謂無功于中國，語其王則未也，過夷狄則","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207356456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436995701866531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"遠矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207356456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"周之東遷，文武之功德于是乎盡矣，猶","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207372840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"能維持二十四君。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207372840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"王室不絶如綫，夷狄不敢","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207389224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"屠害中原者，由五伯借名之力也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207389224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"是故知能","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207405608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"以力率天下者，天下亦以力歸焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207405608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"所以聖人","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207421992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"有言曰：眇能視，跛能履，履虎尾，咥人㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207421992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"武人","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207438376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"爲于大君。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207438376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"其斯之謂歟？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207454760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"夫意也者，盡物之性也；言也者，盡物之情也；","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207471144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"象也者，盡物之形也；數也者，盡物之體也；仁","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207471144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"也者，盡人之聖也；禮也者，盡人之賢也；義也","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207471144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"者，盡人之才也；智也者，盡人之術也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207471144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"盡物之","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207487528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436988890431507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"性者謂之道，盡物之情者謂之德，盡物之形","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207487528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"者謂之功，盡物之體者謂之力，盡人之聖者","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207487528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之化，盡人之賢者謂之教，盡人之才者謂","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207487528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"之勸，盡人之術者謂之率。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207487528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"道德功力者，存乎","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207503912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"體者也；化教勸率者，存乎用者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207503912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"體用之間","logicSentenceId":"7648861491207520296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":261, ineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"此四者，天","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382239247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"地始則始焉，天地終則終焉，終始隨乎天地","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382239247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382239247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"夫古今者，在天地之間，猶旦暮也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382255631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"以今","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382272015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436988890447891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"觀今，則謂之今矣；以後觀今，則今亦謂之古","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382272015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382272015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"以今觀古，則謂之古矣；以古自觀，則古亦","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382288399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之今矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382288399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"是知古亦未必爲古，今亦未必爲","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382304783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"今，皆自我而觀之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382304783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"安知千古之前，萬古之","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382321167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"後，其人不自我而觀之也？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382321167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"若然，則皇帝王伯","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382337551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"者，聖人之時也；","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382337551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00031_0_62","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648861491382337551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"書","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00031_0_63","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648861491382337551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"詩","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00031_0_64","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648861491382337551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00031_0_65","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648861491382337551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"者，聖人之經也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382337551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"時有消長，經有因革。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382353935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"時有消長，否泰盡之矣；","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382370319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"經有因革，損益盡之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382370319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"否泰盡，而體用分，損","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382386703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"益盡而心跡判。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382386703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"體與用分，心與跡判，聖人之","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382403087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"事業，于是乎備矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382403087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"所以自古當世之君天下","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382419471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436988890497043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"者，其命有四焉：一曰正命，二曰受命，三曰改","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382419471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"命，四曰攝命。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382419471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"正命者，因而因者也；受命者，因","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382435855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"而革者也；改命者，革而因者也；攝命者，革而","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382435855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"革者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382435855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"因而因者，長而長者也；因而革者，長","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382452239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"而消者也；革而因者，消而長者也；革而革者，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382452239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"消而消者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382452239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"革而革者，一世之事業也；革而","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382468623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"因者，十世之事業也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382468623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"因而革者，百世之事業","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382485007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382485007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"因而因者，千世之事業也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382501391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"可以因則因，可","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382517775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"以革則革者，萬世之事業也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382517775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"一世之事業者，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382534159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"非五伯之道而何？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382534159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"十世之事業者，非三王之","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382550543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437002106437643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"道而何？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382550543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"百世之事業者，非五帝之道而何？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382566927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"千","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382583311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"世之事業者，非三皇之道而何？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382583311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"萬世之事業","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382599695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"者，非仲尼之道而何？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382599695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"是知皇帝王伯者，命世","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382616079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂也；仲尼者，不世之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382616079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼曰：殷因于","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382632463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"夏禮，所損益可知也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382632463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"周因于殷禮，所損益可","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382648847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"知也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382648847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"其或繼周者，雖百世可知也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382665231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"如是，則何","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382681615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"止于百世而已哉？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382681615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"億千萬世皆可得而知之","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382697999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382697999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"人皆知仲尼之爲仲尼，不知仲尼之所以","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382714383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"爲仲尼，不欲知仲尼之所以爲仲尼則己，如","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382714383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"其必欲知仲尼之所以爲仲尼，則捨天地將","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382714383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437002106470411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"奚之焉？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382714383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"人皆知天地之爲天地，不知天地之","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382730767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"所以爲天地，不欲知天地之所以爲天地則","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382730767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"已，如其必欲知天地之所以爲天地，則捨動","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382730767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"靜將奚之焉？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382730767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"夫一動一靜者，天地至妙者歟！","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382747151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"夫一動一靜之間者，天地人至妙至妙者歟！","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382763535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"是故知仲尼之所以能盡三才之道者，謂其","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382779919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"行無轍跡也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382779919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

Type":1,"content":"而下，祖三皇也；自堯、舜而下，宗五帝也；自文、","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382829071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"武而下，子三王也；自桓、文而下，孫五伯也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382829071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"祖","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382845455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"三皇，尚賢也；宗五帝，亦尚賢也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382845455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"三皇尚賢以","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382861839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"道，五帝尚賢以德。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382861839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"子三王，尚親也；孫五伯，亦","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382878223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"尚親也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382878223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"三王尚親以功。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382894607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"五伯尚親以力。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382910991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼！","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382927375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"時之既往，億萬千年；時之未來，亦億萬千年。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382943759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"何祖宗之寡，而子孫之多耶？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382960143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"此所以重贊堯、","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382976527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"舜至禹，曰：禹，吾無間然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382976527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼後禹千五百","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382992911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"餘年，今之後仲尼又千五百餘年，雖不敢比","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382992911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"德仲尼，上贊堯、舜、禹，豈不敢如孟子上贊仲","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382992911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437002106503179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"尼乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491382992911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"人謂仲尼惜乎無土，吾獨以爲不然。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383009295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"疋","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383025679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"夫以百畒爲土，大夫以百里爲土，諸侯以四","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383025679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"境爲土，天子以四海爲土，仲尼以萬世爲土。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383025679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"若然，則孟子言自生民已來，未有如夫子，斯","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383042063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不爲之過矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383042063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人不能自富，必待天與其","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383058447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"富，然後能富。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383058447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"人不能自貴，必待天與其貴，然","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383074831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"後能貴。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383074831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"若然，則富貴在天也，不在人也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383091215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"有求","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383107599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"而得之者，有求而不得者矣，是繫乎天者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383107599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"功德在人也，不在天也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383123983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"可修而得之，不修則","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383140367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"不得，是非繫乎天也，繫乎人者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383140367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人之能","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383156751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437002106535947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"求而得富貴者，求其可得者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383156751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"非其可得者，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383173135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"非所以能求之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383173135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"昧者不知，求而得之，則謂","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383189519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"其己之能得也，故矜之；求而不得，則謂其人","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383189519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"之不與也，故怨之。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383189519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"如知其己之所以能得，人","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383205903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"之所以能與，則天下安有不知量之人邪？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383205903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383222287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"下至富也，天子至貴也，豈可妄意求而得之","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383222287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"也？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383222287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然，天命亦未始不由積功累行，聖君艱","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383238671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"難以成之，庸君暴虐以壞之，是天歟？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383238671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"是人歟？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383255055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"是知人作之咎，固難逃已。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383271439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"天降之災，禳之奚","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383287823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"益？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383287823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"積功累行，君子常分，非有求而然也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383304207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"有求","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383320591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436999363461147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"而然者，所以謂利乎仁者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383320591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"君子安有餘事","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383336975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"于其間哉？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383336975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"然而有幸與不幸者，始可以語命","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383353359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"也已。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383353359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"夏禹以功有天下，夏桀以虐失天下；殷","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383369743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"湯以功有天下，殷紂以虐失天下，周武以功","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383369743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"有天下，周幽以虐失天下。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383369743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"三者雖時不同，其","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383386127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"成敗之形一也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383386127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"平王東遷，無功以復王業；赧","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383402511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"王西走，無虐以喪王室。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383402511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"威令不逮一小國，諸","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383418895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"侯仰存于五伯而已。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383418895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"此又奚足道哉？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383435279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"但時無","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383451663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"眞王者出焉，雖有虛名與𣏌宋，其誰曰少異？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383451663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"是時也，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383468047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00031_0_71","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648861491383468047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"之作，不亦冝乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383468047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"傳","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00031_0_78","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648861491383582735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"稱子貢欲去魯告朔之餼羊，孔子曰：賜也，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383582735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"爾愛其羊，我愛其禮。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383582735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"是知名存實亡者，猶愈","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383599119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437002106519563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"于名實俱亡者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383599119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"禮雖廢而羊存，則後世安","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383615503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"知無不復行禮者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383615503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"晋文公尊王，雖用虛名，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383631887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"猶能力使天下諸侯知有周天子，而不敢以","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383631887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"兵加之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383631887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"及晋之衰也，秦由是敢滅周。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383648271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"斯愛","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383664655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"禮之言，信不誣矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383664655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"齊景公嘗一日問政于孔子，孔子對曰：君君，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383681039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"臣臣，父父，子子。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383681039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：善哉！","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383697423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"信如君不君，臣不","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383713807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"臣，父不父，子不子，雖有粟，吾得而食諸？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383713807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"是時","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383730191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"也，諸侯僭天子，陪臣執國命，禄去公室，政出","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383730191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"私門。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383730191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"景公自不能上奉周天子，欲其臣下奉","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383746575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436995701964835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"己，不亦難乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383746575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"厥後齊祚卒爲田氏所移。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383762959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"夫齊","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383779343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"之有田氏者，亦猶晋之有三家也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383779343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"晋之有三","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383795727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"家者，亦猶周之有五伯也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383795727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"韓、趙、魏之于晋也，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383812111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"旣立其功，又分其地；旣卑其主，又奪其國。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491383812111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"田","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499630607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"氏之于齊也，既得其禄，又專其政；既殺其君，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499630607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"又移其祚。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499630607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"其如天下之事，豈無漸乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499646991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"履霜之","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499663375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"戒，寧不思乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499663375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"傳","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00031_0_79","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648861491499679759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"稱：王者，往也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499679759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"能往天下者，可","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499696143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"以王矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499696143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"周之衰也，諸侯不朝天子久矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499712527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"及楚","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499728911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"預中國會盟，仲尼始進爵爲之子，其于僭王","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499728911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"也，不亦陋乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499728911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436999363477531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"夫以力勝人者，人亦以力勝之。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499745295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"吴嘗破越，而","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499761679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"有輕楚之心，及其破楚，又有驕齊之志。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499761679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"貪婪","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499778063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"攻取，不顧德義，侵侮齊晋，專以夷狄爲事，遂","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499778063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"復爲越所滅。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499778063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"越又不監之，其後復爲楚所滅。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499794447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"楚又不監之，其後復爲秦所滅。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499810831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"秦又不監之，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499827215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"其後復爲漢所代。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499827215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"恃强凌弱，與豺虎何以異","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499843599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499843599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"非所以謂之中國義理之師也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499859983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"宋之爲國","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499876367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"也，爵高而力卑者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499876367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"盟不度德，會不量力，區","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499892751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"區與諸侯並驅中原，恥居其後，其于伯也，不","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499892751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"亦難乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499892751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436999363493915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"周之同姓諸侯而克永世者，獨有燕在焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499909135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"燕","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499925519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"處北陸之地，去中原特逺，苟不隨韓、趙、魏、齊","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499925519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"楚較利刃，爭虛名，則足以養德待時，觀諸侯","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499925519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"之變。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499925519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"秦雖虎狼，亦未易加害。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499941903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"延十五六年後，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499958287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"天下事未可知也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499958287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"805","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"中原之地，方九千里，古不加多，而今不加少，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499974671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"然而有祚長祚短、地大地小者，攻守異故也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499974671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"自三代以降，漢唐爲盛。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491499991055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"秦界于周漢之間矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500007439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"秦始盛于穆公，中于孝公，終于始皇。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500023823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"起于西","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500040207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"夷，遷于岐山，徙于咸陽，兵瀆宇内，血流天下，","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500040207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436995702013987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"並吞四海，更革今古，雖不能比德三代，非𣈆、","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500040207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"隋可同年而語也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500040207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"其祚之不永，得非用法太","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500056591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"酷，殺人之多乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500056591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"所以仲尼序","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500072975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"書","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00031_0_80","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648861491500072975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"，終于","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500072975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"秦誓","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00031_0_81","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648861491500072975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500072975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"事，其㫖不亦逺乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500072975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"823","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"夫好生者，生之徒也；好殺者，死之徒也。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500089359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"周之","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500105743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"好生也以義，漢之好生也亦以義；秦之好殺","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500105743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"也以利，楚之好殺也亦以利。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500105743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"周之好生也以","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500122127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"義，而漢且不及；秦之好殺也以利，而楚又過","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500122127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500122127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"天之道，人之情，又奚擇于周、秦、漢、楚哉？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500138511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"擇","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500154895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"乎善惡而已。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500154895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"是知善也者無敵于天下，而天","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500171279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436995701997603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"下共善之；惡也者，亦無敵于天下，而天下亦","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500171279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"共惡之。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500171279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"天之道，人之情，又奚擇于周、秦、漢、楚","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500187663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"哉？","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500187663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"擇乎善惡而已。","logicSentenceId":"7648861491500204047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
