{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"昔者孔子語堯、舜，則曰垂衣裳而天下治；語","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503893001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"湯、武，則曰順乎天而應乎人。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503893001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"斯言可以該古","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503909385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"今帝王受命之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503909385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"堯禪舜以德，舜禪禹以","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503925769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"功。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503925769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"以德，帝也；以功，亦帝也；然而德下一等，則","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503942153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"入于功矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503942153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"湯伐桀以放，武伐紂以殺。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503958537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"以放，王","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503974921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"也；以殺，亦王也；然而放下一等，則入于殺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503974921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"是知時有消長，事有因革，前聖後聖，非出于","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503991305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437015779934243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"一途哉！","logicSentenceId":"7648866738503991305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"20","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"天與人相爲表裏。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504007689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"天有陰陽，人有邪正。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504024073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"邪正","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504040457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"之由，繫乎上之所好也。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504040457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"上好德，則民用正；上","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504056841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"好佞，則民用邪。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504056841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"邪正之由，有自來矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504073225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"雖聖君","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504089609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"在上，不能無小人，是難其爲小人；雖庸君在","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504089609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"上，不能無君子，是難其爲君子。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504089609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"自古聖君之","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504105993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"盛，未有如唐堯之世，君子何其多耶！","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504105993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"時非無","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504122377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"小人也，是難其爲小人，故君子多也；所以雖","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504122377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"有四凶，不能肆其惡。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504122377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"自古庸君之盛，未有如","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504138761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"商紂之世，小人何其多耶！","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504138761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"時非無君子也，是","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504155145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437002106601483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"難其爲君子，故小人多也。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504155145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"所以雖有三仁，不","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504171529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"能遂其善。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504171529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"是知君擇臣、臣擇君者，是繫乎人","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504187913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"也；君得臣、臣得君者，是非繫乎人也，繫乎天","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504187913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504187913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"賢愚人之本性，利害民之常情。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504204297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"虞舜陶于河","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504220681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"濱，傅說築于巖下，天下皆知其賢，而百執事","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504220681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"不爲之舉者，利害使之然也。","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504220681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"吁！","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504237065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"利害叢于中，","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504253449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"而矛戟森于外，又安知有虞舜之聖，而傅說","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504253449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"之賢哉？","logicSentenceId":"7648866738504253449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"河濱非禪位之所，巖下非求相之方。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848063526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"昔也在億萬人之下，而今也在億萬人之上，","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848079910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436999363624987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"相去一何逺之甚也！","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848079910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"然而必此云者，貴有名","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848096294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848096294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00032_0_1","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648867074848112678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：坎，有孚，維心亨，行有尚，中正行險，","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848112678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"徃且有功，雖危無咎。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848112678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"能自信故也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848129062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"伊尹以之，","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848145446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"是知古之人患名過實者有之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848145446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"其間有幸","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848161830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"與不幸者，雖聖人力有不及者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848161830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"伊尹行冡","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848178214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"宰，居責成之地，借使避放君之名，豈曰不忠","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848178214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848178214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"則天下之事去矣，又安能正嗣君，成終始","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848194598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"之大忠者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848194598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"吁，若委寄于匪人，三年之間，其","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848210982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"如嗣君何？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848210982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"則天下之事亦去矣，又安有伊尹","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848227366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"也？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848227366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"坎有孚，維心亨，不亦近之乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848243750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436999363657755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00032_0_2","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648867074848260134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：由豫，大有得，勿疑，朋盍簪。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848260134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"剛徤主豫，動","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848276518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"而有應，群疑乃亡，能自强故也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848276518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"周公以之，是","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848292902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"知聖人不能使人無謗，能處謗者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848292902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"周公居","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848309286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"緫已當任重之地，借使避滅親之名，豈曰不","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848309286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"孝乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848309286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"則天下之事去矣，又安能保嗣君，成終","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848325670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"始之大孝者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848325670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"吁，若委寄于匪人，七年之間，","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848342054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"其如嗣君何？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848342054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"則天下之事亦去矣，又安有周","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848358438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"公也？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848358438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"由豫，大有得，勿疑，朋盍簮，不亦近之乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848374822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天下將治，則人必尚行也；天下將亂，則人","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848391206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"必尚言也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848391206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"尚行則篤實之風行焉；尚言則詭","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848407590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437002106634251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"譎之風行焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848407590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"天下將治，則人必尚義也；天下","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848423974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"將亂，則人必尚利也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848423974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"尚義則謙讓之風行焉；","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848440358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"尚利則攘奪之風行焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848440358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"三王尚行者也，五伯","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848456742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"尚言者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848456742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"尚行者必入于義也，尚言者必入","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848473126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"于利也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848473126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"義利之相去，一何逺之如是耶！","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848489510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"是知","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848505894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"言之于口不若行之于身，行之于身不若盡","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848505894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"之于心。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848505894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"言之于口，人得而聞之；行之于身，人","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848522278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"得而見之；盡之于心，神得而知之。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848522278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"人之聦明","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848538662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"猶不可欺，况神之聦明乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848538662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"是知無愧于口不","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848555046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"若無愧于身，無愧于身不若無愧于心。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848555046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"無口","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848571430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436999363608603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"過易，無身過難；無身過易，無心過難。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848571430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"旣無心","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848587814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"過，何難之有？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848587814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"吁！","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848604198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"安得無心過之人而與之語","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848620582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"心哉！","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848620582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"是故知聖人所以能立乎無過之地者，","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848636966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"謂其善事于心者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848636966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼曰：","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848669734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"韶","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00032_0_4","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648867074848669734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"盡美矣，又盡善也；","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848669734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"武","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00032_0_5","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648867074848669734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"盡美矣，未盡","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848669734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"善也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848669734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：管仲相桓公，霸諸侯，一匡天下，民","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848686118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"到于今受其賜。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848686118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"微管仲，吾其被髮左袵矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848702502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848718886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"知武王雖不逮舜之盡善盡美，以其解天下","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848718886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"之倒懸，則下于舜一等耳。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848718886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"桓公雖不逮武之","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848735270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437015779901475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"應天順人，以其霸諸侯，一匡天下，則高于狄","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848735270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"亦逺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848735270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"以武比舜，則不能無過；比桓，則不能","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848751654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"無功。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848751654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"以桓比狄，則不能無功；比武，則不能無","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848768038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"過。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848768038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"漢氏宜立乎其武、桓之間矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848784422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"是時也，非會","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848800806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"天下民厭秦之暴且甚，雖十劉季、百子房，其","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848800806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"如人心之未易何？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848800806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"且古今之時則異也，而民","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848817190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"好生惡死之心非異也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848817190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"自古殺人之多，未有","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848833574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"如秦之甚，天下安有不厭之乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848833574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"夫殺人之多","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848849958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"不必以刃，謂天下之人無生路可趍也，而又","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848849958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"况以刃多殺天下之人乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848849958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"秦二世，萬乘也，求","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848866342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436999363641371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"爲黔首而不能得；漢劉季，疋夫也，免爲元首","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848866342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"而不能已。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848866342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"萬乘與疋夫相去有間矣，然而有","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848882726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"時而代之者，謂其天下之利害有所懸之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848882726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"天之道，非禍萬乘而福疋夫也，謂其禍無道","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848899110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"而福有道也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848899110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"人之情非去萬乘而就匹夫也，","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848915494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"謂其去無道而就有道也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848915494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"萬乘與疋夫相去","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848931878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"有間矣，然而有時而代之者，謂其直以天下","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848931878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"之利害有所懸之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848931878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"日旣没矣，月旣望矣，星不能不希矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848948262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"非星之","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848964646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"希，是星難乎爲其光矣，能爲其光者不亦希","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848964646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437002106617867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848964646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"漢、唐旣創業矣，吕、武旣擅權矣，臣不能不","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848981030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"希矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848981030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"非臣之希，是臣難乎爲其忠矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074848997414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"能爲其","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849013798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"忠者不亦希乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849013798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"是知從天下事易，死天下事","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849030182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"難；死天下事易，成天下事難。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849030182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能成之，又何","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849046566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"計乎死與生也？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849046566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"如其不成，雖死奚益？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849062950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"况其有","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849079334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"正與不正者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849079334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"與其死于不正，孰若生于正？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849095718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"與其生于不正，孰若死于正？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849112102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"在乎忠與智者","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849128486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"之一擇焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849128486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"死固可惜，貴乎成天下之事也；如","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849144870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"其敗天下之事，一死奚以塞責？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849144870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"生固可愛，貴","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849161254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"乎成天下之事也；如其敗天下之事，一生何","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849161254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437018367803429"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"以收功？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849161254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"噫！","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849177638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"能成天下之事，又能不失其正而","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849194022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"生者，非漢之留侯、唐之梁公而何？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849194022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"微斯二人，","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849210406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"則漢、唐之祚或幾乎移矣，豈若虛生虛死者","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849210406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"焉？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849210406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"夫虛生虛死者，譬之蕭、艾，忠于智者，不由","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849226790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"乎其間矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849226790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼曰：善人爲邦百年，亦可以勝殘去殺。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849259558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"誠","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849275942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"哉是言也！","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849275942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"自極亂至于極治，必三變矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849292326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"三皇","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849308710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"之法無殺，五伯之法無生。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849308710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"伯一變至于王矣，","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849325094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"王一變至于帝矣，帝一變至于皇矣，其于生","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849325094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372436999363674139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"也，非百年而何？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849325094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"是知三皇之世如春，五帝之","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849341478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"世如夏，三王之世如秋，五伯之世如冬。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849341478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"如春","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849357862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"温如也，如夏燠如也，如秋凄如也，如冬冽如","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849357862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849357862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏秋、冬者，昊天之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849374246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00032_0_7","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648867074849390630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"、","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849390630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"書","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00032_0_8","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648867074849390630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"、","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849390630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"詩","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00032_0_9","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648867074849390630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"、","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849390630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00032_0_10","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648867074849390630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"者，","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849390630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人之經也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849390630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"天時不差則歲功成矣，聖經不","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849407014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"忒則君德成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849407014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"天有常時，聖有常經，行之正","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849423398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"則正矣，行之邪則邪矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849423398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"邪正之間，有道在焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849439782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"行之正則謂之正道，行之邪則謂之邪道。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849456166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"邪","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849472550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"正由人乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849472550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"由天乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849488934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"天由道而生，地由道而成，","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849505318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"物由道而形，人由道而行。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849505318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"天地人物則異也，","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849521702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437015780016163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"其于由道一也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849521702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"夫道也者，道也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849538086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"道無形，行之","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849554470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"則見于事矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849554470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"如道路之道坦然，使千億萬年","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849570854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"行之人知其歸者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849570854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：君子道長則小人","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849587238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"道消，君子道消則小人道長。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849587238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"長者是，則消者","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849603622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"非也；消者是，則長者非也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849603622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"何以知正道邪道","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849620006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"之然乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849620006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"吁！","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849636390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"賊夫人之論也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849652774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"不曰君行君事，臣","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849669158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"行臣事，父行父事，子行子事，夫行夫事，妻行","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849669158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"妻事，君子行君子事，小人行小人事，中國行","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849669158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"中國事，夷狄行夷狄事，謂之正道。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849669158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"君行臣事，","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849685542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"臣行君事，父行子事，子行父事，夫行妻事，妻","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849685542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437002106716171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"行夫事，君子行小人事，小人行君子事，中國","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849685542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"行夷狄事，夷狄行中國事，謂之邪道。","logicSentenceId":"7648867074849685542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"至于三","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162700838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":162,"lineType":1,"content":"代之世治，未有不治人倫之爲道也；三代之","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162700838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"世亂，未有不亂人倫之爲道也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162700838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"後世之慕三","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162717222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"代之治世者，未有不正人倫者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162717222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"後世之慕","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162733606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"三代之亂世者，未有不亂人倫者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162733606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"自三代","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162749990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"而下，漢唐爲盛，未始不由治而興，亂而亡，况","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162749990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"其不盛于漢唐者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162749990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"其興也，又未始不由君","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162766374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"道盛，父道盛，夫道盛，君子之道盛、中國之道","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162766374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"盛。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162766374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"其亡也，又未始不由臣道盛，子道盛，妻道","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162782758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437002106732555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"盛，小人之道盛，夷狄之道盛。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162782758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"噫！","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162799142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"二道對行，何","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162815526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"故治世少而亂世多耶？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162815526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"君子少而小人多耶？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162831910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：豈不知陽一而陰二乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162848294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"天地尚由是道而","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162864678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"生，况其人與物乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162864678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"人者，物之至靈者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162881062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"物之","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162897446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"靈未若人之靈，尚由是道而生，又况人靈于","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162897446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"物者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162897446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"是知人亦物也，以其至靈，故特謂之","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162913830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"人也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677162913830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"伯之皇，以力行道之","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163159590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"事也；伯之帝，以力行德之事也；伯之王，以力","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163159590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"行功之事也；伯之伯，以力行力之事也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163159590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"時有","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163175974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"消長，事有因革，非聖人無以盡之。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163175974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"所以仲尼","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163192358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：可與共學，未可與適道；可與適道，未可與","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163192358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437015780098083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"立；可與立，未可與權。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163192358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"是知千萬世之時，千萬","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163208742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"世之經，豈可畫地而輕言也哉？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163208742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"三皇，春也；五","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163225126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"帝，夏也；三王，秋也；五伯，冬也；七國，冬之餘冽","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163225126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163225126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"漢王而不足，𣈆伯而有餘；三國，伯之雄者","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163241510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"也；十六國，伯之叢者也；南五代，伯之借乘也；","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163241510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"北五朝，伯之傳舍也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163241510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"隋，晋之子也；唐，漢之弟","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163257894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"也；隋季諸郡之伯，江漢之餘波也；唐季諸鎮","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163257894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"之伯，日月之餘光也；後五代之伯，日未出之","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163257894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"星也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163257894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"自帝堯至于今，上下三千餘年，前後百","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163274278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"有餘世，書傳可明紀者，四海之内，九州之間，","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163274278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437015780114467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"其間或合或離，或治或隳，或强或羸，或唱或","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163274278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"隨，未始有兼世而能一其風俗者。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163274278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"吁！","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163290662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"古者謂","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163307046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"三十年爲一世，豈徒然哉！","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163307046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"俟化之必洽，教之","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163323430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"必浹，民之情始可一變矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163323430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"苟有命世之人，繼","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163339814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"世而興焉，則雖民如夷狄，三變而帝道可舉。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163339814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"惜乎！","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163356198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"時無百年之世，世無百年之人，比其有","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163372582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"代，則賢之與不肖，何止于相半也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163372582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"時之難不","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163388966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"其然乎！","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163388966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"人之難不其然乎！","logicSentenceId":"7648867677163405350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

nt":"謂之性者，盡之而後可知也；所以謂之命者，","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222518810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437040228499490"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"至之而後可知也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222518810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"此三知者，天下之眞知也，","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222535194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"雖聖人無以過之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222535194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"而過之者，非所以謂之","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222551578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222551578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"夫鑑之所以能爲明者，謂其能不隱","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222567962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物之形也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222567962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然，鑑之能不隱萬物之形，未","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222584346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"若水之能一萬物之形也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222584346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然，水之能一萬","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222600730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"物之形，又未若聖人之能一萬物之情也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222600730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"聖","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222617114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"人之所以能一萬物之情者，謂其聖人之能","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222617114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"反觀也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222617114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"所以謂之反觀者，不以我觀物也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222633498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"不","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222649882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"以我觀物者，以物觀物之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222649882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"旣能以物觀","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222666266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"物，又安有我于其間哉？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222666266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"是知我亦人也，人亦","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222682650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437022855839780"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"我也，我與人皆物也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222682650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"此所以能用天下之目","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222699034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"爲己之目，其目無所不觀矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222699034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"用天下之耳爲","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222715418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"已之耳，其耳無所不聽矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222715418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"用天下之口爲己","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222731802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"之口，其口無所不言矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222731802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"用天下之心爲已之","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222748186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"心，其心無所不謀矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222748186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天下之觀，其于見也，","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222764570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"不亦廣乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222764570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之聽，其于聞也，不亦逺乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222780954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222797338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"下之言，其于論也，不亦高乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222797338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之謀，其于","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222813722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"樂也，不亦大乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222813722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"夫其見至廣，其聞至逺，其論","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222830106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"至高，其樂至大，能爲至廣至逺至高至大之","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222830106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"事，而中無一爲焉，豈不謂至神至聖者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222830106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"非","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222846490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437040228483106"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"唯吾謂之至神至聖者乎，而天下謂之至神","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222846490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"至聖者乎！","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222846490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"非唯一時之天下謂之至神至聖","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222862874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"者乎，而千萬世之天下謂之至神至聖者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222862874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"過此以徃，未之或知也已。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677222879258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"天數五，地數五，合而爲十，數之全也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314727974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"天以一","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314744358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"而變四，地以一而變四。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314744358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"四者有體也，而其一","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314760742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"者無體也，是謂有無之極也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314760742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"天之體數四而","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314777126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"用者三，不用者一也；地之體數四而用者三，","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314777126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"不用者一也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314777126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"是故無體之一，以况自然也；不","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314793510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"用之一，以况道也；用之者三，以况天地人也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314793510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"體者八變，用者六變。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314809894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"是以八卦之象，不易者","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314826278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437022855905316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"四，反易者二，以六卦變而成八也；重卦之象，","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314826278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"不易者八，反易者二十八，以三十六變而成","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314826278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"六十四也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314826278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"故爻止于六，卦盡于八，策窮于三","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314842662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"十六，而重卦極于六十四也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314842662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"卦成于八，重于","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314859046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"六十四，爻成于六，策窮于三十六，而重于三","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314859046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"百八十四也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314859046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"天有四時，一時四月，一月四十日，四四十六","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314875430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"而各去其一，是以一時三月，一月三十日也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314875430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"四時，體數也；三月三十日，用數也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314891814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"體雖具四，","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314908198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"而其一常不用也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314908198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"故用者止于三而極于九","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314924582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437018367983653"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314924582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"體數常偶，故有四有十二；用數常奇，故有","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314940966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"三有九。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314940966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"大數不足而小數常盈者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314957350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"以其大者不","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314973734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"可見，而小者可見也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314973734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"故時止乎四，月止乎三，","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314990118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"而日盈乎十也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677314990118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"是以人之交，體有四而指有","logicSentenceId":"7648867677315006502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"十也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677315006502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"天體數四而用三，地體數四而用三。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677315039270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"天尅地，","logicSentenceId":"7648867677315055654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"地尅天，而尅者在地，猶晝之餘分在夜也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677315055654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7648867677315072038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437040228597794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"以天三而地四。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677315072038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"天有三辰，地有四行也。","logicSentenceId":"7648867677315088422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"然地","logicSentenceId":"7648867677315104806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"之大，且見且隱，其餘分之謂邪？","logicSentenceId":"7648867677315104806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"689","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"圓數有一，方數有二，奇偶之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154646043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"六即一也，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154662427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"十二即二也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154662427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"天圓而地方，圓者，數之起一而積六，方者，數","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154678811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"之起一而積八，變之則起四而積十二也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154678811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"六","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154695195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"者常以六變，八者常以八變，而十二者亦以","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154695195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"八變，自然之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154695195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"八者，天地之體也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154711579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"六者，天","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154727963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154727963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"十二者，地之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154744347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"天變方爲圓，而常","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154760731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"存其一。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154760731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"地分一爲四，而常執其方。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154777115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"天變其體","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154793499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437046092234779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"而不變其用也，地變其用而不變其體也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154793499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"六","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154809883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"者并其一而爲七，十二者并其四而爲十六","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154809883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154809883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"陽主進，故天并其一而爲七。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154826267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"陰主退，故地","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154842651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"去其四而止於十二也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154842651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"是陽常存一，而陰常","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154859035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"晦一也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154859035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"故天地之體止於八，而天之用極于","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154875419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"七，地之用止于十二也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154875419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"圓者刓方以爲用，故","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154891803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"一變四，四去其一則三也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154891803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"三變九，九去其三","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154908187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"則六也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154908187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"方者引圓以爲體，故一變三，並之四","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154924571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154924571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"四變十二，并之十六也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154940955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"故用數成於三，而","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154957339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"極於六；體數成於四，而極于十六也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154957339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"是以圓","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154973723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437054115823668"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"者徑一而圍三，起一而積六；方者分一而爲","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154973723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"四，分四而爲十六，皆自然之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449154973723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"958","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"奇數極於四而五不用，策數極于九而十不","logicSentenceId":"7648868449221967881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437046092316699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"用。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449221967881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"五則一也，十則二也，故去五十而用四十","logicSentenceId":"7648868449221984265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"九也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449221984265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"奇不用五，策不用十，有無之極也，以况","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222000649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"自然之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222000649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"965","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有六十四，而用止六十者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222017033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"六十卦者，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222033417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"三百六十爻也，故甲子止于六十也，六甲而","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222033417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"天道窮矣，是以策數應之。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222033417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"三十六與二十四，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222049801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"合之則六十也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222049801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"三十二與二十八，合之亦六","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222066185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"十也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222066185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"天一地二，天三地四，天五地六，天七地八，天","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222344713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"九地十，參伍以變，錯綜其數也，如天地之相","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222344713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"銜，晝夜之相交也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222344713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"一者數之始，而非數也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222361097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222377481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"二二爲四，三三爲九，四四爲十六，五五爲二","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222377481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"十五，六六爲三十六，七七爲四十九，八八爲","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222377481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"六十四，九九爲八十一，而一不可變也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222377481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"百則","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222393865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"十也，十則一也，亦不可變也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222393865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"是故數去其一","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222410249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"而極于九，皆用其變者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222410249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"五五二十五，天數","logicSentenceId":"7648868449222426633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","page {"lines":[{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"自下而上謂之升，自上而下謂之降。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449284948018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"升者生","logicSentenceId":"7648868449284964402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"也，降者消也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449284964402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"故陽生於下，而陰生於上，是以","logicSentenceId":"7648868449284980786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物皆反生。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449284980786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"陰生陽，陽生陰，陰復生陽，陽復","logicSentenceId":"7648868449284997170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"生陰，是以循環而無窮也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449284997170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
