{"lines":[{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437073137106953"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"本一氣也，生則爲陽，消則爲陰，故二者一而","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285079090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"已矣，六者三而已矣，八者四而已矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285079090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"是以言","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285095474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"天而不言地，言君而不言臣，言父而不言子，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285095474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"言夫而不言婦也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285095474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"然天得地而萬物生，君得","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285111858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"臣而萬化行，父得子、夫得婦而家道成。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285111858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"故有","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285128242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"一則有二，有二則有四，有三則有六，有四則","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285128242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"有八。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285128242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽生而分二儀，二儀交而生四象，四象交","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285144626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"而成八卦，八卦交而生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285144626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"故二儀生天地","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285161010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"之類，四象定天地之體；四象生八卦之類，八","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285161010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437073137041417"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"卦定日月之體；八卦生萬物之類，重卦定萬","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285161010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"物之體。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285161010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"類者，生之序也；體者，象之交也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285177394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"推類","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285193778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"者必本乎生，觀體者必由乎象。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285193778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"生則未來而","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285210162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"逆推，象則旣成而順觀。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285210162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"是故日月一類，物同","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285226546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"出而異處也，異處而同象也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285226546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"推此以往，物奚","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285242930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"逃哉？","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285242930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"天變時而地應物，時則陰變而陽應，物則陽","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285259314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"變而陰應。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285259314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"故時可逆知，物必順成。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285275698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"是以陽迎","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285292082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"而陰隨，陰逆而陽順。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285292082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"語其體，則天分而爲地，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285308466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"地分而爲萬物，而道不可分也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285308466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"其終則萬物","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285324850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437073137090569"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"歸地，地歸天，天歸道，是以君子貴道也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285324850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"有變則必有應也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285341234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"故變于内者應于外，變于","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285357618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"外者應于内，變于下者應于上，變于上者應","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285357618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"于下也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449285357618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"天變而日應之，故變者從天，而應者","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485062153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"法日也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485062153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"是以日紀乎星，月會於辰，水生於土，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485078537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"火潜於石，飛者棲木，走者依草，心肺之相聯，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485078537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"肝膽之相屬，無它，應變之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485078537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"本乎天者親上，本乎地者親下，故變之與應，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485094921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"常反對也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485094921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"陽交於陰，而生蹄角之類也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485111305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"剛交於柔，而生","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485127689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437054116085812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"根荄之類也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485127689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"陰交於陽，而生羽翼之類也；柔","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485144073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"交於剛，而生枝榦之類也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485144073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"天交於地，地交於","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485160457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"天，故有羽而走者，足而騰者，草中有木，木中","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485160457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"有草也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485160457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"各以類而推之，則生物之類，不逃數","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485176841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485176841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"走者便於下，飛者利於上，從其類也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485193225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"陸中之物，水中必具者，猶影象也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485209609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"陸多走，水","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485225993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"多飛者，交也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485225993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"是故巨于陸者必細于水，巨于","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485242377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"水者必細于陸也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485242377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"虎豹之毛猶草也，鷹鸇之羽猶木也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485258761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"木者星之子，是以果實象之。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485275145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437054116102196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"葉，陰也，華實，陽也，枝葉耎而根榦堅也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485291529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"人之骨巨而體繁，木之榦巨而葉繁，應天地","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485307913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485307913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"動者體横，植者體縱，人宜横而反縱也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485324297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"飛者有翅，走者有趾，人之兩手，翅也；兩足，趾","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485340681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485340681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"飛者食木，走者食草，人皆兼之，而又食飛走","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485357065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故最貴於萬物也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485357065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"天地有八象，人有十六象，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485422601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"合天地而生","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485438985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"人，合父母而生子，故有十六象也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485438985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"心居肺，膽居肝，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485455369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"言性者必歸之天，言體","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485471753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"者必歸之地。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485471753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"地中有天，石中有火，是以心膽","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485488137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437070473723915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"象之也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485488137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"心膽之倒懸，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485504521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"草木者，地之本體","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485520905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"也，人與草木反生，是以倒懸也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485520905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"口目横而鼻","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485537289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"縱，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485537289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"體必交也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485553673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"故動者冝縱而反横，植者","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485570057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"冝横而反縱，皆交也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485570057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"天有四時，地有四方，人有四支。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485586441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"是以指節可","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485602825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"以觀天，掌文可以察地，天地之理，具乎指掌","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485602825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"矣，可不貴之哉！","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485602825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"神統於心，氣統於腎，形統於首，形氣交而神","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485619209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"主乎其中，三才之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485619209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"人之四攴，各有脉也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485635593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"一脉三部，一部三候，以","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485651977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437070473756683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"應天數也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485651977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"心藏神，腎藏精，脾藏魂，膽藏魄，胃受物而化","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485668361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"之，傳氣於肺，傳血於肝，而傳水穀於脬腸矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485668361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"天圓而地方，天南高而北下，是以望之如倚","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485684745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485684745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"地東南下，西北高，是以東南多水，西北","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485701129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"多山也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485701129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"天覆地，地載天，天地相函，故天上有","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485717513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"地，地上有天。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485717513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"天渾渾於上而不可測也，故觀斗數以占天","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485733897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485733897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"斗之所建，天之行也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485750281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"魁建子，杓建寅，星以","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485766665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"寅爲晝也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485766665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"斗有七星，是以晝不過乎七分也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485783049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437070473773067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":664,"lineType":2,"content":"更詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"天行所以爲晝夜，日行所以爲寒暑。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485799433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"夏淺冬","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485815817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"深，天地之交也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485815817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"左旋右行，天日之交也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485832201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"日朝在東，夕在西，隨天之行也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485848585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"夏在北，冬在","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485864969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"南，隨天之交也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485864969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"天一周而超一星，應日之行","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485881353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485881353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"春酉正，夏午正，秋卯正，冬子正，應日之交","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485897737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485897737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"日以遲爲進，月以疾爲退。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485914121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"日月一會而加半","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485930505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"日，减半日，是以爲閏餘也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485930505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"日一大運而進六","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485946889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"日，月一大運而退六日，是以爲閏差也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485946889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437073137139721"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"日行陽度則盈，行陰度則縮，賔主之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485963273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"月","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485979657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"去日則明盈而遲，近日則生而疾，君臣之義","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485979657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485979657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"陽消則生陰，故日下而月西出也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449485996041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"陰盛則敵","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486012425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，故日望而月東出也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486012425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"天爲父，日爲子，故天","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486028809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"左旋，日右行。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486028809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"日爲夫，月爲婦，故日東出，月西","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486045193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"生也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486045193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"日月相食，數之交也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486061577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"日望月則月食，月掩日","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486077961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"則日食，猶木火之相尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486077961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"是以君子用智，小","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486094345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"人用力。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486094345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437073137156105"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"日隨天而轉，月隨日而行，星隨月而見。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486110729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"故星","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486127113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"法月，月法日，日法天。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486127113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"天半明半晦，日半盈半","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486143497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"縮，月半盈半虧，星半動半靜，陰陽之變化。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486143497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"天晝夜常見，日見於晝，月見於夜而半不見，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486159881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"星半見於夜，貴賤之等也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486159881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"月，晝可見也，故爲陽中之陰；星，夜可見也，故","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486176265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"爲陰中之陽。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486176265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"天奇而地耦。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486192649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"是以占天文者，觀星而已；察地","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486209033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"理者，觀山水而已。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486209033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"觀星而天體見矣，觀山水","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486225417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"而地體見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486225417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"天體容物，地體負物，是故體幾","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486241801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437070473838603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"於道也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486241801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"極南大暑，極北大寒，故南融而北結，萬物之","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486258185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"死地也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486258185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"夏則日隨斗而北，冬則日隨斗而南，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486274569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"故天地交而寒暑和，寒暑和而物乃生也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486274569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"天以剛爲德，故柔者不見；地以柔爲體，故剛","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486290953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"者不生。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486290953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"是以","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486307337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"震","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00033_0_324","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648868449486307337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00033_0_325","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648868449486307337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"，天之陽也；地，陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486307337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"有陽而","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486323721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"陰效之，故至陰者辰也，至陽者日也，皆在乎","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486323721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"天，而地則水火而已。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486323721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"是以地上皆有質之物。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486340105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"陰伏陽而形質生，陽伏陰而性情生。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486356489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"是以陽","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486372873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"生陰，陰生陽，陽剋陰，陰尅陽。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486372873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之不可伏者，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486389257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437077327183887"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"不見於地，陰之不可尅者，不見於天。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486389257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"伏陽之","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486405641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"少者，其體必柔，是以畏陽而爲陽所用。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486405641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"伏陽","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486422025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"之多者，其體必剛，是以禦陽而爲陰所用。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486422025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486438409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"水火動而隨陽，土石靜而隨陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486438409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生陰，故水先成。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486454793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"陰生陽，故火後成。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486471177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽相","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486487561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"生也，體性相須也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486487561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"是以陽去則陰竭，陰盡則","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486503945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"陽滅。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486503945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"金火相守則流，火木相得則然，從其類也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486520329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"水遇寒則結，遇火則竭，從其所勝也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486536713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"陽得陰而爲雨，陰得陽而爲風，剛得柔而爲","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486553097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437070473822219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"雲，柔得剛而爲雷。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486553097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"無陰則不能爲雨，無陽則","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486569481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"不能爲雷。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486569481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"雨，柔也，而屬陰。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486585865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"陰不能獨立，故待","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486602249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"陽而後興。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486602249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"雷，剛也，屬體。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486618633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"體不能自用，必待陽","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486635017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"而後發也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486635017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"有意必有言，有言必有象，有象必有數。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486651401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"數立","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486667785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"則象生，象生則言用，言用則意顯。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486667785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"象數則筌","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486684169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"蹄也；言意則魚兔也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449486684169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"得魚兔而忘筌蹄，則可","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690583090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"也；以筌蹄而求魚兔，則未見其得也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690583090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"天變而人效之，故元亨利貞，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690599474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00033_0_326","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648868449690599474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"之變也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690599474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"人行","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690615858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"而天應之，故吉凶悔吝，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690615858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00033_0_327","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648868449690615858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"之應也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690615858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"以元亨爲","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690632242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437077327200271"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"變，則利貞爲應；以吉凶爲應，則悔吝爲變。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690632242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"元","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690648626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"則吉，吉則利應之；亨則凶，凶則應之以貞；悔","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690648626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"則吉，吝則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690648626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"是以變中有應，應中有變也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690665010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"變","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690681394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"中之應，天道也，故元爲變，則亨應也；利爲變，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690681394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"則應之以貞。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690681394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"應中之變，人事也，故變則凶，應","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690697778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"則吉；變則吝，應則悔也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690697778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"悔者，吉之兆也；吝者，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690714162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"凶之本。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690714162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"是以君子從天不從人。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690730546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"元者，春也，仁","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690746930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690746930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"春者，時之始；仁者，德之長。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690763314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"時則未盛，而德","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690779698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"足以長人，故言德而不言時。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690779698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"亨者，夏也，禮也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690796082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"夏者，時之盛，禮者，德之文。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690812466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"盛則必衰，而文不","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690828850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437077327282191"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"足救之，故言時而不言德。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690828850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰：大哉乾元，而","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690845234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"上之有悔也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690845234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"利者，秋也，義也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690861618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"秋者，時之成，義","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690878002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"者，德之方。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690878002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物方成而獲利，義者不通於利，","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690894386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"故言時而不言德也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690894386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"貞者，冬也，智也。","logicSentenceId":"7648868449690910770" {"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"曆不能無差。","logicSentenceId":"7648870582164013107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"今之學曆者，但知曆法，不知曆","logicSentenceId":"7648870582164029491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437085044817946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"理。","logicSentenceId":"7648870582164029491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"能布筭者，洛下閎也；能推步者，甘公、石公","logicSentenceId":"7648870582164045875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648870582164045875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"洛下閎但知曆法，楊雄知曆法，又知曆理。","logicSentenceId":"7648870582164062259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"一歲之閏，六陰六陽，三年三十六日，故三年","logicSentenceId":"7648870582164078643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"一閏；五年六十日，故五歲再閏。","logicSentenceId":"7648870582164078643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"天時、地理、人","logicSentenceId":"7648870582164095027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"事，三者知之不易。","logicSentenceId":"7648870582164095027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

tent":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437122055143460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"秦穆公有功於周，能遷善改過，爲霸者之最。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377421766702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"𣈆文侯世世勤王，遷平王於洛，次之。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377421783086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"齊桓公","logicSentenceId":"7648874377421799470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"六合諸侯，不以兵車，又次之。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377421799470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"楚莊强大，又次","logicSentenceId":"7648874377421815854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377421815854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"宋襄公雖霸而力微，會諸侯而爲楚所執，","logicSentenceId":"7648874377421832238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"不足論也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377421832238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"治","logicSentenceId":"7648874377421848622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00034_0_54","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648874377421848622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"者，不先定四國之功過，則","logicSentenceId":"7648874377421848622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"事無統理，不得聖人之心矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377421848622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content" {"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：才難，何謂也？","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458581550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：臨大事然後見才之難","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458597934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458597934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：何獨言才？","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458614318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：才者，天之良質也；學者，所","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458630702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"以成其才也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458630702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：古人有不由學問而能立功","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458647086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"業者，何必曰學？","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458647086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：周勃、霍光能成大事，唯其","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458663470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"無學，故未盡善也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458663470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"人而無學，則不能燭理，不","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458679854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"能燭理，則固執而不通。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458679854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"人有出人之才，必以","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458696238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"剛克中。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458696238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"剛則足以立事業，處患難，若用於他，","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458712622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"反爲邪惡。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458712622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"故孔子以申棖爲焉得剛。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458729006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"既有慾","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458745390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"心，必無剛也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458745390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437132918407177"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"君子喻於義，賢人也；小人喻於利而已。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458761774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"義利","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458778158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"兼忘者，唯聖人能之。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458778158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"君子畏義而有所不爲，","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458794542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"小人直不畏耳。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458794542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人則動不踰矩，何義之畏","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458810926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458810926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"599","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"顔子不貳過，孔子曰有不善未嘗不知，知之","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458827310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"未嘗復行是也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458827310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"是一而不再也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458843694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"韓愈以爲將","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458860078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"發於心，而便能絶去，是過與顔子也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458860078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"過與是","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458876462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"爲私意，焉能至於道哉？","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458876462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：與善不亦愈於","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458892846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"與惡乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458892846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：聖人則不如是，私心過與，善惡同","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458909230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458909230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437090686238754"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"爲學養心，患在不由直道。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458925614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"去利欲。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458941998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"由直道任","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458958382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"至誠，則無所不通。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458958382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之道，直而已，當以直","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458974766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"求之。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458974766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"若用智數，由逕以求之，是屈天地而循","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458991150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"人欲也，不亦難乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648874377458991150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"619","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"事無巨細，皆有天人之理。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459007534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"修身，人也；遇不遇，","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459023918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"天也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459023918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"求之者，人也；得之與否，天也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459040302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"得失不動","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459056686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"心，所以順天也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459056686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"强取必得，是逆天理也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459073070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"逆天","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459089454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"理者，患禍必至。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459089454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"一陰一陽之謂道，道無聲無形，不可得而見","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459793966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"者也，故假道路之道而爲名。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459793966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"人之有行，必由","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459810350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"乎道。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459810350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"一陰一陽，天地之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459826734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"物由是而生，由","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459843118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"是而成者也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377459843118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之事，始過於重，猶卒於輕；始過於厚，猶","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714761774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"卒於薄。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714761774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"况始以輕，始以薄者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714778158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"故鮮失之重，","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714794542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"多失之輕；鮮失之厚，多失之薄。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714794542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"是以君子不","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714810926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"患過乎重，常患過乎輕；不患過乎厚，常患過","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714810926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437122055372836"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"乎薄也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714810926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"莊子齊物，未免乎較量。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714827310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"較量則爭，爭則不平，","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714843694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"不平則不和。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714843694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"秦穆公伐鄭，敗而有悔過自誓之言，此非止","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714892846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"霸者之事，幾於王道，能悔則無過矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714892846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"此聖人","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714909230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"所以録於書末也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714909230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"劉絢問無爲，對曰：時然後言，人不厭其言；樂","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714925614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437122055389220"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"然後笑，人不厭其笑；義然後取，人不厭其取。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714925614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"此所謂無爲也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714941998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"瞽瞍殺人，舜視棄天下猶棄","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714958382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"敝屣也，竊負而逃，遵海濱而處，終身訢然，樂","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714958382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"而忘天下。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714958382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人雖天下之大，不能易天性之","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714974766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"愛。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714974766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"文中子曰：易樂者，必多哀；輕施者，必好奪。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377714991150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"或","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715007534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天下皆爭利棄義，吾獨若之何？","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715007534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：舍其","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715023918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"所爭，取其所棄，不亦君子乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715023918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"若此之類，禮義","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715040302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"之言也，心迹之判久矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715040302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"若此之類，造化之言","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715056686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715056686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"人之爲道當至於鬼神不能窺處，是爲至矣。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715269678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"作","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715286062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00034_0_140","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648874377715286062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"者其知盗乎？","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715286062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人知天下萬物之理而","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715302446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"一以貫之，","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715302446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"大羮可和，玄酒可漓，則是造化亦可和可漓","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715318830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715318830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"有一日之物有一月之物，有一時之物，有一","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715335214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437122055421988"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"歳之物，有十歳之物，至於百千萬皆有之。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715335214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715351598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"地亦物也，亦有數焉。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715351598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":677,"lineType":2,"content":"雀三年之物，馬三十年之物，凡飛走之物皆可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":678,"lineType":2,"content":"以數推。人，百有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":679,"lineType":2,"content":"二十年之物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"太極道之極也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715367982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"太玄","objectRef":{"refId":"DZ1040_00034_0_141","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"7648874377715384366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"道之玄也，太素色之本","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715384366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"也，太一數之始也，太初事之初也，其成功則","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715384366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715384366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715384366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"易地而處，則，無我也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715400750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"隂者陽之影，鬼者人之影也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715417134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"氣以六變，體以四分。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715433518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"以尊降卑曰臨。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715449902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"以上觀下，曰觀。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715466286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7372437122055405604"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毋","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715482670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"意毋必，毋固毋我。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715482670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"合而言之則一，分而言","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715499054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"之則二；合而言之則二，分而言之則四。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715499054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"始於","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715515438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"有意，成於有我。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715515438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"有意然後有必，必生於意。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715531822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"有","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715548206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"固然後有我，我生於固。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715548206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"意有心固不化我有","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715564590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"己也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715564590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"記問之學，未足以爲事業。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715580974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"智哉！","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715597358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"留侯善藏其用。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715613742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"時然後言，言不在我也。","logicSentenceId":"7648874377715646510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
